name: scroll-area
title: Scroll area
description: A region that scrolls inside a height limit with thin themed scrollbars, keyboard reachable.

when: A long list or pane must stay within a fixed height.

keyboard.does: Moves focus into the region so arrow keys scroll it.

builtIn: The region is focusable and announced by its label.

ScrollArea.name: aria-label
ScrollArea.description: Names the region; screen readers announce it when focus enters.

ScrollArea.name: maxHeight
ScrollArea.description: The region's height limit ("320px", 320, "60vh"); for horizontal areas, set the width on the parent.

ScrollArea.name: fill
ScrollArea.description:
Fills the parent's height and scrolls inside it, for a pane in a flex column or a grid
row that is given its height: a conversation's messages between its header and the reply box, a list
beside it. The parent must give the area a definite height (`min-h-0` on a flex or grid child).
Leave `maxHeight` out when filling.
